title: EndpointsProbeResult
description: Result of the endpoints.probe JSON-RPC method — the Test button's whole meaning: it probes what will actually be used, a real streaming completion through the same engine the ask transaction will use, not one cheap completion (design §4.5, bead notes). The params are the form's DRAFT values (name, baseUrl, key, model) — the endpoint may not be saved yet, and the key is an input that never crosses back (ADR-0030). This schema is the SINGLE declaration of the probe result shape: agent.status's lastProbe references this whole file cross-file.

name.description: The probed draft's display name. Historical fact: agent.status reports the last probe whatever the endpoint list says now.

model.description: The model id that was probed — the form tests its first model.

ok.description: True when the probe streamed at least one content chunk — the endpoint answered with an answer.

error.description: What went wrong when ok is false: the dial failure, the HTTP status, the refused stream, zero content. Absent when ok.

elapsedMs.description: Total wall time of the probe, dial to end of stream.
